text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr paces around the
waiting room
as the clock ticks down to
post time.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes, don't fret. I'm simply surrendering
myself to
the wind blowing forth from
within.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
There's a severe cyclone dancing inside
me. It
wants to burst free and sweep up
everything in its
rapid winds!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I mustn't act rashly, but... I'm just so
eager to play
with the wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I am. Just watch—I'm going to whip up a
derecho
out there on the track!
